whoItsFor: Developers using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others) who want the agent to write less code and avoid unnecessary abstractions, dependencies, and over-engineering.
useCases: Keep an AI coding agent from building custom classes or libraries when a one-line or standard-library solution exists
Run /ponytail-review to review diffs for bugs, security, and missing tests while flagging code that can be cut
Run /ponytail-audit to rank whole-repo issues and find the highest-priority fixes
